90: export function injectLiveReloadScript(html: string): string {

93:   var scheme = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss://' : 'ws://';
94:   function connect() {
95:     var ws = new WebSocket(scheme + window.location.host + '${RELOAD_PATH}');
